caveat: Wholesale scenario: simulated energy priced at CAISO/WEIM real-time wholesale LMPs. A data center pays a retail tariff or contract (demand charges, transmission, fees), not these prices.
note: not part of the registered experiment; validation window only; wholesale real-time prices applied to registered ledgers after the fact (the router never saw a price)
title: What moving and waiting cost, at wholesale real-time prices

window.rule: the registered cohort window: eval_start to the last hour any priced cohort ledger still runs

prices.source: CAISO OASIS PRC_RTPD_LMP (15-minute market, real time), hourly mean
prices.why_real_time: PACE has no day-ahead price before EDAM (May 2026, inside the sealed window); real-time marks are used for every site

nodes.rule: the load aggregation point a load at each site would settle at: the WEIM ELAPs; CISO has no location inside California, so it is computed at both large CAISO load zones (california_node)

prices.pricing_rule: hourly means of the four 15-minute LMPs; a partial hour of a job is priced at that hour's mean

price_taker.rule: the cluster is assumed too small to move any price

coverage.rule: an hour is priced at a site when all four 15-minute LMPs exist; an hour counts only when it is priced at every site; unpriced hours are excluded for every policy (energy, cost and CO₂ count zero there)

transfer_rule: a moved job's transfer energy (5% of its IT energy, × PUE) is priced half at Utah and half at the destination, at the UTC hour of the job's arrival, as in the CO₂ accounting
decomposition_rule: Δcost vs U = level + timing; level = Σ_site MWh × the site's mean price over the priced hours, minus U's; level = extra energy (ΔMWh × PACE mean price: the transfer energy valued at Utah's mean) + location (MWh placed at a site whose mean price differs from PACE's, including the destination half of the transfer energy); timing = the rest (when the energy is drawn vs each site's mean)
per_tonne_rule: cost per attributed tonne = (cost − cost_U) / (attributed CO₂_U − CO₂) on the priced hours; negative = cheaper and lower-carbon; attributed (average-intensity) CO₂, not a marginal abatement cost

S.label: Static ranking: move to the cleanest-on-average site
